compiler_notes: Closest candidate uses nopeephole; one lwz addresses the size field through the computed block pointer rather than the original payload pointer. Ordinary peephole fixes its address but reorders two instruction pairs, leaving 12 differing bytes. No code modifications or masking applied. Later const payload-view/getter experiments generate the original load address but change scheduling; isolated read-order and metadata-helper variants remain unmatched.
